title: Recover stale or abandoned benchmark materialization state
description: The atomic staging and per-target lock implementation at commit 50ee194 addresses the live concurrent-clone race recorded by the original DATAP-19ad97 issue on the curation branch, but stale and abandoned states still wait until the 15-minute timeout. Correct the concurrency state machine so waiting is justified only by a live fresh lock, waiters re-evaluate when the lock disappears, stale locks are removed safely, abandoned staging directories cannot block progress, and incomplete legacy targets are repaired without racing an active owner. Add behavior-level process concurrency tests covering peer success, peer failure, stale lock, partial target without a lock, and recovery without a 15-minute wait.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Re-audit of 73222e9: focused tests, TypeScript, and scoped ESLint pass, but concurrency is still unsafe. runMaterializeOrchestration calls cleanupAbandonedStaging before inspecting or acquiring the lock, so a follower can delete a live leader staging directory. removeStaleOrDeadLock removes an aged lock even when the owner PID is alive, while releaseLock removes whatever lock exists without verifying ownership; a slow live clone can lose its lock and later delete a replacement owner's lock. The process test named follower-waits-for-leader starts the follower first and does not assert follower action=used-existing, so it does not prove the intended ordering. Required repair: start the leader first, wait until its lock and staging path are observable, then start the follower; prove the active staging directory survives and the follower returns used-existing. Clean staging only after exclusive lock ownership. Make lock release conditional on an ownership token or equivalent, and do not break a live owner's lock without a safe lease/heartbeat protocol.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Manager re-audit at 3a47c4b passes. The process test now starts the leader, waits for its lock and staging directory, then starts the follower and proves leader=materialized, follower=used-existing, and the live staging marker survives. Cleanup occurs after exclusive acquisition; live locks are not removed by age; release is ownership-token-gated. Independent verification: 9 suites/73 tests, TypeScript, and scoped ESLint pass. Technically resolved pending implementation PR merge.
